summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the new CODES I.D. editable-identity + chat-style + message-playback features on /chirpconnect. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests PASS (BASE=https://binaural-preview.preview.emergentagent.com) covering PUT /api/mirrors/{id}/change_id success/404/400/409 + old-id-404-after-change + display_name & contacts preservation, plus regression on register, lookup, contacts add, display_name update, and WS /api/mirrors/live/{id}. Frontend: SETTINGS tab shows IDENTITY section with editable DISPLAY NAME + MIRRORS I.D. inputs and SAVE IDENTITY button; saving with valid name='TESTER1' and fresh id='TUPOI3' updated the header MIRRORS I.D. text and both values persisted after full page reload (verified via input values + AsyncStorage keys @codes_display_name / @codes_mirrors_id). CHAT STYLE INFRARED/MATRIX/MONO pills work; selecting MATRIX writes localStorage @codes_chat_style=MATRIX which persists across reload and MIRROR-HISTORY bubbles adopt the theme (bubble bg=rgb(4,16,7)=#041007 matches CHAT_THEMES.MATRIX.bubble). MESSAGES tab tap-to-play works end-to-end: a seeded CODES chirp bubble shows '▶ TAP TO PLAY' → tap flips to '■ PLAYING — TAP TO STOP' → auto-reverts to '▶ TAP TO PLAY' within ~8s (AudioEngine webview bridge is the timer source) → subsequent tap-again toggle to stop works. Regression: MIRROR tab PTT hold/release produced 0 console.error, CONTACTS tab renders BROADCAST + ADD CONTACT, and RETROSUPERFUTURE is absent from every tab (MIRROR/MESSAGES/CONTACTS/SETTINGS). Deprecated packages detected: expo-av still present (Metro logs '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54').

react_native_issues.issue: expo-av is deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Migrate audio playback to expo-audio and video playback (used for message playback modal in this iteration) to expo-video. Reference: /app/frontend/app/chirpconnect.tsx (imports Audio and Video from 'expo-av')

Alert.alert() does not render a visible dialog on the web preview — 'Identity Updated', 'Invalid MIRRORS I.D.', 'I.D. Taken', and 'CODES Sent' alerts fire in code but produce no DOM/dialog output for web users. Functional flow still works (state + persistence verified). Consider an in-app toast/banner for web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/chirpconnect.tsx:478, 482, 493, 511, 513, 540, 825

action_items: OPTIONAL (framework migration): replace expo-av with expo-audio (Sound) and expo-video (Video modal) before SDK 54 upgrade. All message-playback + PTT recording paths import from expo-av today.

OPTIONAL (web UX): Alert.alert is invisible on react-native-web — 'Identity Updated' / 'Invalid MIRRORS I.D.' / 'I.D. Taken' confirmations don't surface for web users. Consider a lightweight in-app toast for Platform.OS==='web'.
OPTIONAL (testability): add testID attributes to identity inputs, SAVE IDENTITY button, chat-style pills, and message bubbles to remove reliance on text-content selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: chirpconnect.tsx is now 1799 lines (grew from 1568) — well beyond the 700-line guideline; strongly recommend splitting into feature modules (identity/settings, message-bubble+playback, codes-archive picker, PTT recorder, chat-theme provider).

PUT /api/mirrors/{id}/change_id passes new_id as a query param (not a JSON body). This works and is validated (regex ^[A-Z0-9]{4,10}$), but a JSON body would be more RESTful and self-documenting. Non-blocking.

saveIdentity() swallows exceptions from change_id + display_name fetches with bare try/catch {} (chirpconnect.tsx:497,506) — a network failure will still show 'Identity Updated' to the user while state diverges from server. Consider surfacing partial-failure feedback.

change_id endpoint does a copy-then-delete of the mirrors_ids document; not atomic. If the process is interrupted between insert_one and delete_one both IDs could briefly exist. Consider a transaction or rename primitive. Low risk in single-writer environment.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (identity edit + persistence + invalid-format guard + chat-style + tap-to-play + auto-stop + regression all pass)

seed_data_creation: For MESSAGES-tab playback UI validation, seeded one synthetic CODES chirp into localStorage key @chirp_history (Schumann Fundamental / 7.83 Hz) after backend flow of picking from CODES ARCHIVE proved brittle to headless UI clicks. Playback state machine (idle → playing → idle) verified against the seeded item — this exercises the same playMessage() code path used by real user-sent CODES chirps.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All CODES I.D. + editable-identity + chat-style + message-playback features are working. Backend change_id endpoint is fully covered by pytest (parametrized bad-format, taken, unknown-source, success + preservation). Frontend Alert.alert is invisible on web preview but functional state changes are verifiable via header text / TextInput values / localStorage keys (@codes_mirrors_id, @codes_display_name, @codes_chat_style, @chirp_history). expo-av deprecation warning still present — should be migrated before SDK 54. No red-screen errors, no failing APIs, no broken flows.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature validation run, no bugs identified.
